title: Generic higher OM residual extensions
objective: Certify the next generic nonlinear order-two OM residual extension through exact residual operators, type evidence, and maximal-order lattice differentials

oracles: Sage/PARI exact local index and maximal-order lattice

validation: node --test --test-name-pattern bounded OM/MaxMin agrees|independent checking rejects test/number-field-om-maxmin.cjs

runs.command: node --test --test-name-pattern bounded OM/MaxMin agrees|independent checking rejects test/number-field-om-maxmin.cjs

handoff.summary: Adds the exact GMN order-two residual coefficient operator for one active linear first residual type, generic finite-field factor branching for terminal side length at most two, and an exact quotient-product/HNF local basis.  On pari-round4-vector-429 at p=5 the inspectable tree has four degree-16 terminal branches and index 132; its independently closure-checked denominator-3125 lattice is byte-for-byte equal to the localization of the frozen PARI maximal-order lattice.  The same ordinary Python source passes in CPython and Sage.js, and a corrupted triangular numerator is rejected.
risks: The v429 p=2 and p=3 residual polygons have lengths four and eight and intentionally remain higher-residual-degree-unsupported.
The exact Sage.js p=5 path is about 15.4 seconds versus 1.5 seconds in CPython, so public auto selection remains disabled.
Only linux-x64 was exercised in this bounded lane; integration CI retains responsibility for the other declared first-class platforms.
The number-field-algorithms package is 618628/625000 bytes on this base, leaving 6372 bytes for follow-up work.
next_steps: Generalize the residual coefficient operator and quotient basis to longer terminal polygons and recursive nonlinear prior residue factors for the v429 p=2 and p=3 branches.
Profile and source-transparently accelerate the exact Sage.js quotient/HNF and closure path before considering any automatic engine selection.
Run the broad native/platform matrix after integration; no handwritten native code or public selector changes are part of this lane.
